Context: 3. Qualifying Service

11. Intimation to employees about their qualifying service.The Head of Office in consultation with the Accounts Officer is required to issue a certificate regarding qualifying service after completion of 18 years of service and again 5 years before the date of retirement of an employee. Further, the verification done under this rule shall be treated as final and shall not be re-opened except under certain conditions. The service verification certificate should invariably be issued to the Government servant
